How the score is calculated

If you win at least as many tricks as you called, you score your call plus 0.1 for every extra trick. Call 4 and win 6, and you score 4.2. If you win fewer tricks than you called, you lose your call: call 5 and win 3, and you score −5.

The tracker checks that the tricks in each round add up to 13, so a typing slip at the table can't spoil the totals. Tap Undo last to fix the previous round.
